I'm not sure you understand how cancer works...

Cancer occurs when two primary mechanisms in a cell fail. First, the cell's ability to replicate fails in such a manner that the cell begins replicating uncontrollably, while also passing on the failure through DNA to the new copies. Second, cells have a kill mechanism in place that will take out the cell when the first replication mechanism fails in the above-referenced manner. In order for cells to become cancerous, the kill mechanism must fail before the replication mechanism fails.
